newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close off an interest rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close off an interest rates rise.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed off in light trade as yields on six-month Central Bank TEM paper, used as a benchmark for wider interest rates, rose 80 basis points to 16.89 percent in Wednesday's auction, traders said.
The bolsa's 19-share .IBC index slipped 0.24 percent to 6,321.48 points on 13.9 million shares worth 2.5 billion bolivars ($5.2 million).
"The market was very quiet...but there's still interest in Electricidad de Caracas on coming rate rises, and in Sudamtex B shares after George Soros's purchase," said Financorp broker Miguel Ortiz.
New York based financier George Soros bought 20 percent of the textile company on Monday. The stock closed up 0.9 bolivars at 40.90.
Among total traded issues, 15 fell, 12 rose and 14 closed flat. Merinvest's composite index, which includes telephone company CANTV, lost 0.14 percent to end at 97.23 points.
